record.title: Coordinated Plan on Artificial Intelligence
record.summary: Communication in which the European Commission, with the Member States, sets out joint actions to build up AI in Europe: investment, research excellence, skills, data availability and public-sector uptake. It covers ethics guidelines drafted by the High-Level Expert Group on AI, a Commission assessment of whether EU safety and liability frameworks fit AI, and security aspects of AI applications. Member States are asked to adopt national AI strategies by mid-2019.
record.notes: Adopted as a Communication to the European Parliament, the European Council, the Council, the European Economic and Social Committee and the Committee of the Regions, with an annex holding the plan itself. The Commission's AI Office landing page shows a last update of 11 October 2021.
record.scope_note: A coordination plan whose main content is investment, research and uptake of AI; ethics guidelines, safety and liability frameworks and security are only some of its action areas, so it is included as a borderline strategy.

judgment.status_reasoning: A Communication invites the Council and Member States to endorse and implement the plan; it creates no binding duties and no repeal or replacement is stored. The Commission's landing page still lists it as a current publication (last update 11 October 2021). A later review of the plan exists but is not stored, so the status stays Published (non-binding, current).
judgment.scope_reasoning: Strategy with some risk-governance content (ethics guidelines, safety and liability gap assessment, security); borderline, included with a scope note under the general rules.
